This is covert data exfiltration performed without user consent or transparency in the manifest and is characteristic of malicious behavior.

This postinstall.js collects sensitive host data (hostname, user info, cwd/homedir, private and public IP, process info) and automatically POSTs that JSON to external domains (including suspicious insomnia1102.online hosts). Running as a postinstall hook with no consent and sending identifiable system/network details to remote endpoints is characteristic of data-exfiltration / phone-home behavior, not benign telemetry — this is deliberate malicious behavior.
